misses.text:
Worst Delivery & Customer Support

Very disappointing experience with Myntra. My delivery was delayed, and despite raising multiple complaints and requesting support, there was no proper resolution or callback.

After all the frustration, I finally had to cancel the delayed order myself, and Myntra refunded ₹0. No proper explanation, no meaningful customer support, and no resolution.

Extremely poor service and a frustrating experience. I would not recommend Myntra based on this experience.
